errors.refused: Strict403/400/415/413/408/429/503 preconditions; invalid token400; unknown/operational completion503 RESET_UNCONFIRMED without retry promise

preconditions: Owner supplies actual socket ConnectInfo and lifetime-admitted executor with safe logging/connection retirement
No default product data opener or writer authority; existing migration/release gates remain binding
postconditions: Callback302 is non-consuming and Location is revalidated; HEAD405 invokes no native handler
Completion200 only after known commit; unknown/operational failure remains503 without replay or rollback claim
Shared4 blocking jobs and4096 fixed-operation/IP buckets, callback/completion10/60; issuance3/60 remains
Retained UI handles unconfirmed/transport/malformed ACK without replay or false success
external_effects: Only trusted admitted executor may perform native recovery transaction and postcommit mail
No router-owned filesystem lookup, automatic retries, token reissue or session/cookie

authorization.rationale: Do not consume preview, leak bearer to a foreign destination, infer success from unknown commit or auto-replay lost responses; preserve trusted owner lifetime and global exposure gates.
